- name: Cache Gradle packages
  uses: actions/cache@v3

      ~/.gradle/caches
      !*gluecodium*
      !*lime-*

```

Actually, looking at the repository context, there are multiple Gradle projects: root build.gradle, gluecodium/build.gradle, functional-tests/build.gradle, etc. The cache key hashes all *.gradle files. The exclusions `!*gluecodium*` and `!*lime-*` might be to avoid caching artifacts from local modules that are built as part of the build (publishToMavenLocal).

The build step does: `./gradlew publishToMavenLocal` then runs cmake tests. So the Gradle build publishes to maven local, and the cache might be caching those local publications which could be stale.
